{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''gang''' of [[Slaver/Legends|enslavers]] were professional raiders working for Malak, a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] enslaver. Malak herself used to lead the gang in attacks against ill-protected communities to kidnap the inhabitants, sometimes with severe damage to the victims.
